items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: Edward is the only one who didn't play anything.

ctx.x: He play every now and then, play ten. Every now and then he get a gig, just play just mostly for kicks. Because he's working for the government now.

Edward is the only one who didn't play anything. Edward didn't play no instrument. But Clarence, Clarence played baritone, I think he played a little Clarence, Herbert, he played Clarence and saxophone. Did you do a sister sing? My sister used to sing. My father was a musician. I had a couple of uncles, a guitar player, and I had one also uncle, a trumpet player. What was his name? Do you remember? His name, uh, Gilles, huh? His nickname was Gilles. We used to call him, his last name was Dewey, huh? We used to…
